question_vi: Bề mặt da trong ảnh là ướt bóng, satin, mờ mịn, hay trắng phẳng?
question_en: Is the skin surface wet, satin, matte, or flat opaque white?
look_where: The forehead and the nose bridge at full zoom. Those two planes face the light most directly, so they show the finish before the cheek does.
why_it_matters: Finish splits the table roughly in half before anything else is asked, and it is the one axis a photo always answers.
trap: A humid-climate face photographs wet by the third hour without anyone having chosen a wet finish. Check whether the shine sits on bone or everywhere.
source: Recall, unverified 2026-07-30; derived from the table's own skin_finish column

question_vi: Còn thấy lỗ chân lông, tàn nhang, vệt màu da không, hay đã mịn hết?
question_en: Are pores, freckles and tonal variation still visible, or has the skin been evened out?
look_where: The cheek beside the nose and the temple. Coverage is applied thinnest at the hairline, so a full base shows its edge there.
options_vi: mỏng, còn thấy da|trung bình|dày, phủ kín|để mộc
why_it_matters: Coverage is the axis that decides whether a frame can support a skincare claim. A full base cannot prove skin.
trap: Retouch removes texture after the fact, so this answers what the file shows, not what was on the face. Ask for an unretouched frame when the claim depends on it.
source: Recall, unverified 2026-07-30; derived from the table's own coverage_texture column

question_vi: Chân mày thẳng mềm, chuốt dựng, mảnh cong, hay bị phủ mất?
question_en: Is the brow soft and straight, laminated up, thin and arched, or blocked out?
look_where: The front third of the brow and the direction the hairs point.
options_vi: thẳng mềm|chuốt dựng|mảnh, cong rõ|phủ mất rồi vẽ lại
options_en: soft straight|laminated|thin and arched|blocked out and redrawn
why_it_matters: The brow dates a look and places its region faster than any other feature, and it is the single test that separates Korean no-makeup from clean girl.
trap: Brow shape is also just fashion in the subject's own life. One brow alone should narrow the field, never decide it.
source: Recall, unverified 2026-07-30; derived from the table's own brows column

question_vi: Mí có được dựng nếp không: bỏ trống, phủ một lớp, đánh hốc mắt mềm, cắt nếp rõ, hay là một hình đồ hoạ?
question_en: Is a crease built: nothing, one wash, a soft socket, a cut crease, or a graphic shape?
look_where: Just above the natural fold, with the eye open. A cut crease shows a concealer line that does not follow the fold.
options_vi: không đánh nếp|một lớp phủ|hốc mắt mềm|cắt nếp|hình đồ hoạ
options_en: no crease|one wash|soft socket|cut crease|graphic device
why_it_matters: How the crease is treated separates the commercial lanes from the editorial ones and dates a Western look to within a few years.
trap: A monolid or a hooded lid can hide socket work entirely. If the fold is not visible, this question has no answer and should be skipped rather than guessed.
source: Recall, unverified 2026-07-30; derived from the table's own eyeshadow column

question_vi: Kẻ mắt dày nhất ở đâu: giữa mí, đuôi mắt, hay chỉ kẻ trong chân mi?
question_en: Where is the liner thickest: the centre of the lid, the outer third, or only inside the lash root?
look_where: Trace the liner from the inner corner outward and find its widest point.
options_vi: giữa mí|đuôi mắt, kéo dài|chỉ kẻ chân mi|kẻ trong bờ nước|không kẻ
options_en: centre of lid|outer third, extended|tightline only|kohl on the waterline|bare
why_it_matters: This is the highest-yield single question in the table. Doll-eye, cat eye and siren eye are the same product placed in three different places, and nothing else tells them apart.
trap: A three-quarter head angle foreshortens the outer corner and makes any liner look extended. Judge it on a frontal frame.
source: Recall, unverified 2026-07-30; derived from the table's own liner_lashes column

question_vi: Má hồng nằm ở đâu: dưới mắt, trên gò má, tròn ở táo má, hay kéo lên thái dương?
question_en: Where is the blush: under the eye, on the cheekbone, round on the apple, or swept to the temple?
look_where: Whether the colour crosses the nose bridge, and whether its upper edge is above or below the lower lash line.
options_vi: dưới mắt|qua cả sống mũi|trên gò má|tròn ở táo má|kéo lên thái dương|để trống
options_en: under the eye|across the nose bridge|on the cheekbone|round on the apple|swept to the temple|bare
why_it_matters: Placement, not colour, is what carries the region and the era. Igari crosses the nose; nothing Western does.
trap: A warm grade adds cheek colour that was never applied. Compare the cheek against the ear, which no one blushes.
source: Recall, unverified 2026-07-30; derived from the table's own cheeks column

question_vi: Có tạo khối không, và có thấy được đường viền của khối không?
question_en: Is the face sculpted, and can you see the edge of the sculpting?
look_where: Under the cheekbone and along the sides of the nose. Then ask whether the shading describes the bone or moves it.
options_vi: không tạo khối|khối nhẹ, không thấy viền|có cả khối và bắt sáng|làm hẹp khuôn mặt|bắt sáng thành vệt rõ
options_en: no contour|light, no visible edge|both present|narrows the face|highlight as a hard stripe
why_it_matters: Sculpting separates the Douyin and glam lanes from every clean lane, and a visible highlight edge is what distinguishes Western glass skin from mul-gwang.
trap: Hard side light manufactures contour that no one applied. Check the shadow under the nose for the light's actual direction first.
source: Recall, unverified 2026-07-30; derived from the table's own contour_highlight column

question_vi: Viền môi xử lý thế nào: mờ dần trước viền, đúng viền, hay vẽ tràn ra ngoài?
question_en: What happens at the lip border: does the colour fade out before it, sit on it, or cross it?
look_where: The outer third of the lower lip and the corners of the mouth.
options_vi: mờ dần, không thấy viền|vẽ tràn ra ngoài|đúng viền, cạnh sắc|nhỏ hơn viền thật|chỉ dưỡng môi
options_en: blurred, no border|crosses the border|on the border, hard edge|inside the natural border|balm only
patterns: blurred|past the natural border|hard edge|inside the natural|balm
why_it_matters: Gradient and overlined are opposite techniques filed under the same phrase, full lip. Which side of the border the colour falls on settles a great deal at once.
trap: Gloss on the centre reads as a gradient at low resolution. Zoom to the corner before answering.
source: Recall, unverified 2026-07-30; derived from the table's own lips column

question_vi: Tổng thể ấm hay lạnh, và tương phản cao hay thấp?
question_en: Is the whole face warm or cool, and is the contrast high or low?
look_where: The shadow side of the neck, which the grade affects and the makeup does not.
options_vi: ấm|lạnh|trung tính|tương phản cao|tương phản thấp
why_it_matters: Temperature is the axis most often mistaken for makeup when it is actually the grade, and getting it backwards sends a whole shoot to the wrong palette.
trap: This answers the file's grade, not the products. It is the one axis on this list that can be wrong about the face entirely.
source: Recall, unverified 2026-07-30; derived from the table's own palette_retouch column

question_vi: Có chi tiết nào không thể thấy trên một khuôn mặt bình thường?
question_en: Is there any single feature that could not appear on an ordinary street face?
look_where: Everywhere at once, then name one thing. A drawn fold under the lash, a brow above where a brow can grow, a floating line, a painted white nape.
options_vi: có, một chi tiết|có, nhiều chi tiết|không có
why_it_matters: One unconventional shape means editorial or performance; several mean stage or drag; none means a commercial lane. This is the fastest branch in the whole procedure.
trap: This is the question with no fixed options, so it cannot be looked up. Answer it in words and let it steer which of the others are worth asking.
source: Recall, unverified 2026-07-30; the branch is a reading of the table, not a sourced rule

question_vi: Ánh sáng nào được tính trước: đèn flash, đèn vòng, đèn sân khấu, hay ánh sáng ngày?
question_en: Which light was this built for: flash, a ring light, stage light, or daylight?
look_where: The catchlight in the eye. Its shape names the source, and the makeup was chosen for that source.
options_vi: đèn flash|đèn vòng|đèn sân khấu|ánh sáng ngày|nguồn lớn mềm|nguồn nhỏ gắt
options_en: flash|ring light|stage light|daylight|large soft source|small hard source
why_it_matters: A look copied without its light fails, and the failure gets blamed on the makeup. Mul-gwang under bare flash is not mul-gwang.
trap: A round catchlight can be a ring light or a beauty dish. Check whether the shadow under the nose is soft, which a dish gives and a ring light does not.
source: Recall, unverified 2026-07-30; derived from the table's own photographs_as column

question_vi: Người trong ảnh có phải là người sẽ xuất hiện trong bài của mình không, và mình có quyền dùng ảnh này chưa?
question_en: Is the person in the reference the subject you will publish, and do you have the right to use this image?
look_where: Nothing in the photo answers this. It has to be asked.
options_vi: là người của mình, có quyền|người khác, chỉ tham khảo|chưa rõ quyền
options_en: our own subject, cleared|someone else, reference only|rights unclear
patterns: our own subject, cleared|someone else, reference only|rights unclear
why_it_matters: A public post is a discovery source, not a licence. If the answer is reference only, the makeup grammar can be extracted and the face cannot.
trap: A photograph of a friend or a relative still has a photographer, and the photographer usually holds the copyright.
source: Recall, unverified 2026-07-30; see references/rights-and-claims.md, which is the authority here rather than this row

question_vi: Sản phẩm cần bán là gì, và lớp nền này có nói ngược lại điều sản phẩm hứa không?
question_en: What is the product, and does this base contradict what the product promises?
look_where: Nothing in the photo answers this either.
options_vi: dưỡng da|nền, che phủ|màu môi má mắt|dịch vụ, không bán sản phẩm
options_en: skincare|base and coverage|colour cosmetics|a service, no product
patterns: skincare|base and coverage|colour cosmetics|a service, no product
why_it_matters: A full base cannot prove skin, and a bare face cannot show a lipstick. Half the avoid_when column in the looks table is this one contradiction.
trap: A look can be beautiful and still be the wrong evidence for the claim. Beauty is not the test here.
source: Recall, unverified 2026-07-30; see references/claims-proof-ledger.md for the claim side

question_vi: Ảnh sẽ được xem ở đâu và to bằng nào: thumbnail, feed, in ra, hay video?
question_en: Where will this be seen and at what size: a thumbnail, a feed post, print, or video?
look_where: Not in the photo. Ask, because it changes which looks survive.
options_vi: thumbnail nhỏ|feed điện thoại|in ra|video, phát trực tiếp
why_it_matters: A gradient lip disappears at thumbnail size and a broadcast face looks plain in print. Delivery size eliminates looks that the photo itself cannot rule out.
trap: Most references are found at full size and published small. Judge the candidate at the size it will actually be seen.
source: Recall, unverified 2026-07-30; consistent with data/frame-ratios.csv on placement

question_vi: Thị trường nào, và ở đó cách trang điểm này đọc ra là gì?
question_en: Which market, and how does this look read there?
why_it_matters: Tanned skin, a flushed cheek and red around the eye each carry opposite meanings between markets. The same photograph is aspirational in one and reads as unwell in another.
trap: Do not infer the market from the reference's origin. Where the campaign runs is the market, not where the look came from.
source: Recall, unverified 2026-07-30; see references/dossiers/vietnam-market-context.md for the local reading
